children: FuelCell Energy Inc. (FCEL) filed a Form 8K - Operations and Financial Condition - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 02, 2026.

On September 2, 2026, FuelCell Energy, Inc. (the "Company") issued a press release announcing its financial results and providing a business update as of and for the three and nine months ended July 31, 2026. A copy of this press release is furnished with this report as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated herein by reference.

The information furnished in this Item 2.02, including Exhibit 99.1, is not deemed to be "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), or otherwise subject to the liability of that section. This information will not be deemed to be incorporated by reference into any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "Securities Act"), or the Exchange Act, except to the extent that the Company specifically incorporates it by reference.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/886128/000110465926104498/fcel-20260902x8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/886128/000110465926104498/0001104659-26-104498-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
